Problem.description:
A problem document, as RFC 9457 defines it, answered as ``application/problem+json``.

Attributes:
    model_config (ConfigDict): Forbids unknown keys and freezes the document.
    MEDIA_TYPE (ClassVar[str]): The media type of the document.
    TYPE_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``type`` field.
    TITLE_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``title`` field.
    STATUS_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``status`` field.
    DETAIL_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``detail`` field.
    INSTANCE_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``instance`` field.
    DEFAULT_TYPE (ClassVar[str]): The ``type`` of a problem with no more meaning than its status.
    STATUS_MIN (ClassVar[int]): The lowest status of an error.
    STATUS_MAX (ClassVar[int]): The highest status of an error.
    BEFORE (ClassVar[Literal["before"]]): The mode of the validators.
    type (str): A URI reference that identifies the kind of problem.
    title (str): A short, human-readable summary of the kind of problem.
    status (int): The HTTP status of the answer.
    detail (Optional[str]): A human-readable explanation of this occurrence.
    instance (Optional[str]): A URI reference that identifies this occurrence.

Notes:
    - ``None`` for ``detail`` and ``instance`` means the member is left out of the document.
    - A built problem never changes, so it can be shared between handlers.

SimulationAccepted.description:
The answer of ``POST /v1/simulations``: the simulated flight that has started.

Attributes:
    model_config (ConfigDict): Forbids unknown keys and freezes the answer.
    mission_id (UUID): The Mission the simulated Flight log belongs to.
    drone_ids (List[UUID]): The simulated Drones that fly, in the order of the adapter registry.
    MISSION_ID_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``mission_id`` field.
    DRONE_IDS_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``drone_ids`` field.
    BEFORE (ClassVar[Literal["before"]]): The validator mode that runs before Pydantic's own validation.

Notes:
    - The flight goes on after the answer: its progress and its end are in the simulated Flight log of the
      Mission, as they were for ``fly``.

SimulationRequest.description:
The body of ``POST /v1/simulations``: what a simulated flight of the Squad is started for.

Attributes:
    model_config (ConfigDict): Forbids unknown keys and freezes the request.
    mission_id (UUID): The Mission the simulated Flight log belongs to, a UUID version 7.
    MISSION_ID_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``mission_id`` field.
    BEFORE (ClassVar[Literal["before"]]): The validator mode that runs before Pydantic's own validation.

Notes:
    - It holds what the command line of ``fly`` took, the configuration aside: the app reads that from its own
      ``conf/app.yaml``.

mission_id.description: The Mission the simulated Flight log belongs to, a UUID version 7.
mission_id.title: Mission Id
